content.value: If statements allow you to execute code only when a condition is true. You can also use elif and else for multiple branches.

concepts.name: Conditional statement
concepts.description: A control-flow structure that chooses which code runs based on a condition.

concepts.name: if
concepts.description: The keyword that starts a conditional branch when a condition is true.

concepts.name: elif
concepts.description: A Python keyword for checking an additional condition after a previous if condition was false.

concepts.name: else
concepts.description: The branch that runs when earlier conditions in a conditional statement are false.

concepts.name: Boolean expression
concepts.description: An expression that evaluates to true or false.

concepts.name: Code block
concepts.description: A grouped set of statements that belong to a control structure such as a conditional or loop.
